title: Isithunywa Esabhekana Nabakhulekeli Bezithombe
intro: Ngesikhathi lapho ukuzinikela kwase kulahlekile, isithunywa sasukuma sabiza ukuba sibuyele ekukhulekeleni iNkosi yezwe. Lesi sibalo sama siqinile ngokumelene nabantu ababegxile ekukhulekeleni unkulunkulu wamanga, sibakhumbuza ngoMdali wabo weqiniso neNkosi yokhokho babo. Kodwa abantu abazange balalele futhi benqaba isixwayiso, bavala isiphetho sabo. Wayengubani lo mmemezeli ongantengantengi?
clues: Ngathunyelwa kubantu ababephambukile endleleni kaNkulunkulu Oyedwa Weqiniso.
Ngabatshela ukuthi bayeke ukukhonza unkulunkulu wamanga ogama lakhe linguBali.
Abantu bami benqaba ubizo lwami futhi baqhubeka nokukhonza izithombe zabo.
Ngenxa yokuphika kwabo, ngokuqinisekile bazolethwa ukuze bajeziswe.
INkosi yami yanginika ukuthula kanye nesikhumbuzo esibusisekile phakathi kwezizukulwane ezizayo.
